version: Pajek 6.02 (64-bit, Pajek64.zip of 2025-12-31) under Wine 9.0 on Xvfb
command: Pajek.exe running the startup log Pajek.log: LOADINI specimen.ini (Pajek's SAVEINI defaults, Draw window 1200 x 900); N 1 RDPAJ "<file>" (File > Pajek Project File > Read); E 1 DRAW 1 1 2 0 0 (Draw > Network + First Partition + First Vector + Second Vector); E 1 SVG 1 1 2 0 0 "<out>.svg" 1 0 (Draw > Export > 2D > SVG > General, SVG with Controls); EXIT
varies: Draw > Network + First Partition + First Vector + Second Vector

canvas.requested: 1200 x 900 px (the Draw window's size: Pajek stretches the file's 0..1 coordinates across it, one axis at a time; vertex sizes, line widths and fonts are fixed pixels whatever the window)

fonts: as Pajek writes them (the sheets' font Helvetica, Pajek's own Arial where a sheet sets none); the PNG maps them to the pinned fonts
svgPostprocessing: the CreationDate comment (the run's clock time) is replaced with a fixed text and Windows line ends become Unix ones; nothing else changes. Pajek always adds its signature layer (id PajekSig: the spider logo and the word Pajek, bottom left), which is not part of the network.
